name: bndr-voiceengine
description: Verification and release suite for the full-stack BNDR VoiceEngine

scripts.build: node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:html
scripts.typecheck: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:deno
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:html && npm run test:env && npm run test:matrix && npm run test:endpoints && npm run test:functions && npm run test:security && npm run test:dom
scripts.test:deno: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json --node-modules-dir=manual supabase/functions/ai-proxy/index.ts supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/index.ts supabase/functions/account-delete/index.ts supabase/functions/billing-portal/index.ts supabase/functions/error-report/index.ts supabase/functions/reconcile-subscriptions/index.ts supabase/functions/redeem-access/index.ts supabase/functions/create-checkout/index.ts
scripts.test:html: html-validate index.html app.html privacy.html terms.html pricing.html 404.html 500.html
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:browser && npm run test:deno && npm run test:workflows && npm run test:docker
